title: Release Source Policy
objective: Fail closed before release authority unless an annotated version tag peels to the workflow SHA and its commit is merged into origin/main

oracles: Functional temporary Git repositories cover annotated, lightweight, unmerged, mismatched, and merged-ancestor tag cases
Workflow ratchet tests bind the source-policy environment and full-history checkout

risks: This repository-resident check protects the current workflow and operator path but cannot constrain an older or unmerged tag whose historical workflow omits or rewrites it; protected environment review and manual exact-tip verification remain mandatory, with external tag and branch governance as defense in depth.
